title: Onboarding buddy
description: A guided tour of the project for a new team member, with screenshots from a virtual screen.
prompt: Make an onboarding guide for someone new to this project: set it up from scratch, run it, take screenshots of what they will see (the virtual display :99, e.g. with import or scrot), and write /work/onboarding/README.md with the steps, the screenshots and the five things that surprised you.
